Name: Drink More Water (CP)
Author: Warilized
TagLine: Adds drinkable water into the game. Please re-hydrate yourself in-game and IRL.
Description:
Please drink more water, re-hydrate yourself.

-------------------------------
**About this mod:**
This is a Content Patcher Mod (formerly a Json Asset mod). It adds drinkable water so you can re-hydrate yourself. This mod is designed to be new farmer friendly.

**What's New:**

*   Converting from Json Asset to Content Patcher for ease of updating and developing.

*   Adds Joja Water.

*   Various shop tweak.

*   New Gift taste (still in progress)

*   New Chinese translation
**Installation:**

1.  First, you need to **delete past version** (below 2.0.0)

2.  Make sure you have [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)  and [SMAPI](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400) installed, or else this mod is useless.

3.  If this is your first installation, skip this step. Before placing the mod into "Mods" folder, deleting old mod file (**[JA] Drink More Water**) is recommended to avoid some problems (especially if you are updating from **version 1.4**).

4.  Unzip this mod to "Mods" folder.

5.  Done
**Uninstallation:**

1.  Delete the mod.

2.  Done.
**This Mod Contains:**
This mod comes with several different types of H2O:

*   Raw Water

*   Water

*   Bottled Water (Aquafine)

*   Ionized Water (Carry Sweat)*

*   Purified Water (Pure Slime)*

*   Joja Water*
*Can't be crafted, only machine produce

**Optional Files (DEPRECATED, SEE NOTES):**

*   Kettle (Crafting, default): 10 Woods, 5 Stones. Can be bought at Robin's. Needs [Custom Farming Redux](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991)  .
Used as alternative to cooking if player doesn't have kitchen stuff installed (upgraded house). Boils 4 cups of Raw Water to 4 glass of Water. Needs 1 wood to operate.
*   Rainwater Tank (Crafting, default): 10 Woods, 10 Stones, 5 Fibers. Can be bought at Robin's. Needs [Custom Farming Redux](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991)  .
Gather rainwater when it is raining outside. Only works when it is raining. Produces 10 cups of Raw Water in 100 game ticks.
*   Water Pump (Crafting, default): 15 Woods, 10 Stones, 5 Fibers. Can be bought at Robin's. Needs [Custom Farming Redux](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/991)  .
Pumps water from inside of the Earth. Only works outdoor. Produces 20 cups of Raw Water in 300 game ticks.**Notes:**

*   Due to few circumstances, I'll release the machine (BigCraftables) as a separate mod and only focuses this mod for Crafting and Cooking recipes.
**Planned Updates:**

*   BigCraftables

*   New kind of Water
